en.headline: Four tiny, collectible holiday Squishmallows in one Micromallows set
en.intro: The Micromallows Holiday Wreath is a 4-pack of iconic Squishmallows styles in their smallest and most collectible form yet, made to celebrate the countdown to Christmas. Our concierge checked the set before listing it, and we order it from the overseas seller after you place your order.
highlights: Four holiday favorites come in one pack, so a single order gives you a small collection.
Micromallows are described as tiny but mighty, the smallest and most collectible form of the Squishmallows styles.
Characters like Gina the Gingerbread and Omri the Ornament bring the Christmas countdown theme.
The Holiday Wreath theme makes it a seasonal set for the 2026 holiday season.
It is an Original Squishmallows product, with age tags on the listing starting at 3.

sections.p: The 4-pack features iconic Squishmallows styles shrunk down to Micromallows size, with four holiday favorites to celebrate the Countdown to Christmas. The listing names Gina the Gingerbread and Omri the Ornament and says the set includes more.
A good fit for Squishmallows fans, collectors and anyone looking for a festive gift. Because it is a multi-pack, one order covers a mini collection or several small gifts.

cautions: The listing names two of the four characters (Gina the Gingerbread and Omri the Ornament); the others are not specified.
The listing carries age tags starting at 3.
